svg.title: Headroom, coherent distortion and gain-policy restoration are different tests
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: Headroom, coherent distortion and gain-policy restoration are different tests
Full three-tone peak at the readout, all phases allowed
One in-band IM3 product: worst-phase sum of three stage contributions
At Aᵦ = 49 dB: peak -16.88271 dBm; IM3 bound 0.001050°.
At 46 dB, H may persist but cannot return after L: hysteresis consumes margin.
Cubic curves apply only within qualified stage envelopes; no overload extrapolation.
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
